names: ESMA Museum and Site of Memory
mapIdentity.scope: The named 12-corner Officers’ Quarters footprint on OpenStreetMap way 219731998 anchors the connected exterior and two open rear courts. The rectangular brick-pier entrance projects toward Avenida del Libertador. The designation and the model cover the Officers’ Quarters building.

note: Two original July 2013 photographs show white three-storey plaster wings with dark shuttered windows, the lower wing with tall court windows, and rear higher plaster-and-brick masses with clay tile roofs. Argentina’s nomination records added pitched roofs, exposed brick corners and the entrance porch. Original terrain fixes the approach datum and the slope into both rear courts.
